title: Presidents look into UFOs and find nothing
summary: Michael Shurmer tells of Presidents look into UFOs and find nothing, about 1990s-2020s at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And so every president that gets in there, you know, Clinton and Obama, Trump, you know, we're going to find out what's going on, right?

plain: On the podcast of host Jesse Michels, in a debate where he takes the skeptic's side, a researcher named Michael Shurmer says that every new president, Clinton, Obama and Trump among them, arrives promising to find out what is going on with UFOs. His point, as he tells it, is that they look and come away with nothing, which he takes to mean there may be no hidden secret to find.
